$comment: Model aliases by intelligence tier, plus the permission reviewer's chain. Aliases cannot target other aliases, so every entry is a concrete model. Each tier spans claude-bridge and opencode-go so one exhausted subscription never empties it. Inside opencode-go a $15-limit model falls back to a $60-limit one, never the reverse: once a $60 model is exhausted the Go budget likely is too. claude-bridge serves `reviewer` only through the pi-claude-bridge-standalone-* patches and `provider.allowExtensionSystemPrompts: true` in claude-bridge.json; without them it refuses prompts no pi session recorded. `reviewer` is ordered for latency; its 30s first-event allowance covers claude-bridge Haiku, whose session startup averages ~10s with a tail past 15s.
